pages.text: Press $(k:justlevelingfork.open_aptitudes) to open your aptitude tree — the pack's RPG leveling layer, $(thing)Iridescent Aptitudes$().$(br2)Eight aptitudes (STR, CON, DEX, DEF, MAG, INT, BLD, LCK) gain XP from gameplay actions matching their theme, and unlock skills and passives at threshold levels.

pages.title: Eight Aptitudes
pages.text: $(bold)STR$() Strength — melee damage, physical might$(br)$(bold)CON$() Constitution — HP, hunger, environment$(br)$(bold)DEX$() Dexterity — speed, agility, ranged$(br)$(bold)DEF$() Defense — armor, mitigation, knockback$(br)$(bold)MAG$() Magic — spell power, mana, magic offense$(br)$(bold)INT$() Intelligence — XP gain, knowledge, refunds$(br)$(bold)BLD$() Building — mining, reach, crafting refunds$(br)$(bold)LCK$() Luck — drop rates, jackpot procs

pages.title: Five-tier skills
pages.text: Each aptitude has $(bold)5$() skill nodes at levels $(bold)5 / 10 / 15 / 20 / 30$(). Each tier opens a new ability:$(br2)$(bold)5$() — small confidence-builder bonus$(br)$(bold)10$() — clear functional buff$(br)$(bold)15$() — bridge tier, build-defining$(br)$(bold)20$() — high-signature ability$(br)$(bold)30$() — capstone, often triggered$(br2)Browse each aptitude's five nodes in the aptitude screen itself — hover a node for its exact effect.

pages.title: Always-on passives
pages.text: Some aptitudes also carry per-level passives that scale automatically, no node purchase needed:$(br2)$(bold)MAG$() — Spell Power (up to +16% spell damage at level 32) and Mana Regen (up to +32%)$(br)$(bold)INT$() — Attack Speed and Critical Chance (up to +25% at level 32 — applies to melee, ranged, AND magic)$(br)$(bold)LCK$() — Luck and Critical Damage, so crit chance and crit damage live on different aptitudes and pair naturally.$(br2)$(bold)Next: press $(k:justlevelingfork.open_aptitudes) and spend the points you've banked.$()
